QUERY PLAN
----------------------------------------------------
Seq Scan on departments  (cost=0.00..5000.00 rows=500 width=36) (actual time=0.100..50.000 rows=500 loops=1)
  Filter: (dept_id = ANY (SubPlan 1))
  SubPlan 1
    ->  Subquery Scan  (cost=0.00..10.00 rows=10 width=4) (actual time=0.010..0.100 rows=10 loops=500)
          ->  Seq Scan on employees  (cost=0.00..8.00 rows=10 width=4) (actual time=0.010..0.050 rows=10 loops=500)
                Filter: (employees.dept_id = departments.dept_id)
Total runtime: 50.500 ms
